y-m-80-09.title: Uma kunedijithi yokuhlola, ingabe ingabamba wonke amaphutha okuthayipha?
y-m-80-09.topic: Idijithi yokuhlola yenombolo yencwadi (ISBN) nokuthola amaphutha
y-m-80-09.goal: Hlola ngezibonelo ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zamaphutha okufakwayo idijithi yokuhlola eqinisekile ukuthi izobamba nokuthi yiziphi engase ziphuthe, futhi uchaze umkhawulo wayo ngokwenza wena icala eliyiphuthayo.
y-m-80-09.material:
I-International Standard Book Number (ISBN-13) ekhoveni elingemuva lencwadi ingamadijithi angu-13. Phindaphinda amadijithi okuqala angu-12 ngokulandelana ngo-1, 3, 1, 3, ... futhi uwahlanganise wonke ukuze uthole u-S, futhi idijithi ye-13 (idijithi yokuhlola) yidijithi kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-9 eyenza isamba sibe yinani lokuphindaphinda kwengu-10 uma ihlanganiswa no-S.
Isibonelo (inombolo eqanjiwe): uma amadijithi okuqala angu-12 engu-9 7 8 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9, khona-ke S = 9×1+7×3+8×1+1×3+2×1+3×3+4×1+5×3+6×1+7×3+8×1+9×3 = 133, futhi idijithi yokuhlola ngu-7 (133+7=140).
USeojin wathi, "Njengoba kunedijithi yokuhlola, uma uthayipha inombolo ngephutha, ingabamba wonke amaphutha!"
